description.value: Lennox Pub is a neighbourhood pub at 800 Granville Street in the heart of Vancouver's entertainment district. It offers both indoor and outdoor seating in a smoke-free space and is wheelchair accessible, making it a welcoming mid-ride stop for cyclists moving through downtown. Card payments are accepted.

bike_parking_detail: 7 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 30m; stands (2 spaces) at 31m; stands (2 spaces) at 39m; stands (2 spaces) at 54m; stands (2 spaces) at 54m; stands (2 spaces) at 55m; stands (4 spaces, covered) at 93m. Total: 16 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website URL points to an Instagram profile that returned only generic Instagram login and UI pages — no business-specific content was accessible — so all evidence comes from OSM tags alone. OSM confirms indoor and outdoor seating, wheelchair accessibility, a smoke-free environment, and card payment acceptance, but says nothing about bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or other cycling-specific amenities. With no corroborating website content, all amenity fields without explicit OSM evidence remain null.
concerns: The listed website is an Instagram profile (https://www.instagram.com/thelennoxpub/), which returned only Instagram's generic login wall — no business-specific content could be extracted. Contact details and amenities could not be corroborated via the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Lennox Pub is a real, publicly accessible pub on a major Vancouver street with a current OSM record and no indicators of closure; it is a useful stop for touring cyclists moving through downtown.
